text: The stable CLI contract centers on `og` and `ogd` commands with explicit parsing and error semantics, global `--strict`, finite-enum validation for `--profile` and `--mode`, `--changed` restricted to incremental commands, strict identifier allowlists for `--capsule`/`--ref`/`--certificate`, and repository-relative path validation for optimization inputs such as `--dataset`, `--candidate`, and `--baseline`.
